purpose: Distinguish ranking, calibration, refit shift and unseen-domain generalization; no new training methods claimed effective.

sources.title: scikit-learn: Tuning the decision threshold
sources.adoption: Separate learned scores from decision policy; tune only on model-independent inner calibration roles. Built-in threshold interface is binary, not a direct three-class SOC solution.

sources.title: scikit-learn: Probability calibration
sources.adoption: OOF/disjoint calibration, class coverage, distinguish ranking from calibration; a lower Brier loss alone does not prove calibration improved.

sources.title: Detecting and Correcting for Label Shift with Black Box Predictors
sources.adoption: Do not apply prior correction by default: it assumes stable p(x|y) and invertible confusion; format-support shift may violate both.
